dataset.universe_rule: Existing 22 symbols, fixed before follow-up; selected survivors and overlapping ETFs; no market-wide inference
dataset.availability: historical current-vintage adjusted prices; prospective retrieval times retained

labels.eligibility: label endpoint strictly before fitting decision
labels.purge: endpoint of earlier partition must precede first decision of next partition

splits.outer_design: chronological development validation blocks, expanding eligibility; all inspected history exploratory
splits.inner_design: past model fit, endpoint-purged temperature calibration, distinct endpoint-purged gate validation; no outer outcomes used to choose hyperparameters

primary_endpoints.predictive: paired daily mean log-loss difference candidate minus trailing prior; negative better
primary_endpoints.economic: paired daily net-return difference candidate minus matched costed equal-weight; positive better

inference.unit: session, retaining every symbol within date
inference.multiplicity: Holm family-wise adjustment on actual registered predictive contrasts separately from economic contrasts; exploratory slices descriptive
inference.power: report block-bootstrap standard-error based detectable effect for 80% power, approximate and descriptive
inference.dsr_pbo: excluded: complete independent historical search universe is not recoverable
inference.prospective: Descriptive only: five dates cannot support the registered block-bootstrap inference; no p-values or profitability approval

compute.pilot: first development fold, 2 representative symbols, <=120 seconds
compute.search: bounded one-factor designs; no Cartesian grid and no winner substitution into pilot
compute.failed_trials: retain status/error/runtime and partial artifacts; never overwrite completed trials

pilot.cutoff_rule: Three fixed future XNYS sessions in a fresh account; two prior observations retained as a separate failed segment; never backfill or splice portfolio returns
pilot.refit_anchor: explicit XNYS anchor shared by historical replay and daily path; register runtime before first decision
pilot.weekly: last XNYS session of ISO week (Thursday when Friday is holiday); explicit v2 correction tested before first decision
pilot.schedule: XNYS close+30, retries +45/+60, watchdog +90; segment milestone 3; six hold-only tail sessions
pilot.outcome_maturity: six further sessions after last decision
pilot.refit_scope: No scheduled refit within the three-session continuation window; carried models remain fixed
pilot.ship_scope: Interrupted five-observation report: two archived plus three new, separately disclosed; labels may remain pending

promotion.engineering: exact tested source/config, full critical test IDs and pipeline receipts
promotion.historical_edge: never approved solely by these exploratory follow-ups
promotion.prospective: Separate three-session continuation operational completion from six-session outcome tail; no economic qualification
promotion.manuscript: historical manuscript plus explicitly interim prospective section; full study pending maturity

continuation.design: Five observed decision dates across two explicitly separate segments
continuation.new_account: Fresh 10000 cash per account; no positions, pending orders or fills carried across the gap
continuation.analysis: Descriptive forecasts may be pooled with date/segment identifiers; returns and reliability reported per segment; original failed trial never marked complete
continuation.prior_label_source: Derive later labels from new segment recorded snapshots, in report artifacts only; do not mutate archived prior state
